review.why: The PR only renames the internal helper function from `token_response` to `make_token_response` and updates all call sites accordingly; no public API behavior, response format, validation, or security logic is changed.

personas.name: alice_login_refresh
personas.goal: Log in as alice, then refresh the access token using the refresh token from cookie and verify the new token works.

personas.name: bob_revoke_token
personas.goal: Log in as bob, revoke the token, and confirm it no longer works.

personas.name: carol_password_reset
personas.goal: Request a password reset for carol, use the reset token to set a new password, then log in with the new password.

personas.name: dave_create_posts
personas.goal: Log in as dave, create several posts, then fetch the user's posts and the feed.

personas.name: erin_follow_unfollow
personas.goal: Log in as erin, follow alice, verify following list, then unfollow and verify.

personas.name: frank_bad_login
personas.goal: Attempt to log in with wrong password for frank and expect 401.

personas.name: grace_register_and_post
personas.goal: Register a new user grace, log in, create a post, then edit and delete it.

personas.name: henry_pagination_posts
personas.goal: Log in as alice, fetch posts with various pagination parameters including invalid ones.

personas.name: irene_duplicate_follow
personas.goal: Log in as bob, follow alice twice (second should fail), then unfollow and verify.

personas.name: jack_invalid_post_edit
personas.goal: Log in as carol, create a post, then attempt to edit it with empty text and too long text.

personas.name: karen_unknown_user_follow
personas.goal: Log in as dave, attempt to follow a non-existent user id, then follow a valid user.

personas.name: leo_refresh_reuse_token
personas.goal: Log in as erin, refresh token, then attempt to reuse the old refresh token (should revoke all).
